links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT responses across repeated runs of the same question
links.effect: ChatGPT provided reproducible responses to 91.5% of questions (no difference in grading categories between two responses).
links.quote: ChatGPT provided reproducible responses to 91.5% of questions.

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT answers to patient ophthalmology questions graded by ophthalmologists
links.effect: ChatGPT provided "comprehensive" responses to 70/117 (59.8%) of questions; described as moderate accuracy.
links.quote: Totally, 117 questions were inputted into ChatGPT, which provided "comprehensive" responses to 70/117 (59.8%) of questions.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy and reproducibility of ChatGPT's answers to patient questions in ophthalmology without evaluating a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
